payload.abstract: The HBEDB contains force platform recordings from subjects undergoing stabilography tests. The subjects performed standing tasks under four different conditions: with their eyes opened or closed, while standing on a rigid or unstable surface. Each condition was tested three times, with the order of the conditions being randomized among subjects. A total of 1930 trials performed by 163 different subjects are given in this database.
